user.title: Pro Weather solar forecast
user.description: Paste the API token from your site's dashboard, under Setup > Solar forecast. It starts with pws_.

data_description.base_url: Leave as is unless you are testing against a staging server or a mock.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token needed
reauth_confirm.description: Pro Weather no longer accepts the saved token. It was probably regenerated or revoked. Paste the current token from Setup > Solar forecast.

error.invalid_auth: Pro Weather does not recognise this token. Copy it again from Setup > Solar forecast.
error.plan_required: The solar forecast is part of the Pro plan, and this site is not on it.
error.not_set_up: The token works, but there is nothing to forecast yet: add your panels under Setup > Solar forecast, and make sure the station has a location.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests from your network in the last hour. Try again later.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Pro Weather. Check the connection and try again.
error.invalid_url: The server address must start with https:// or http://.

abort.already_configured: This token is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The new token works. The forecast is back.

init.title: Polling
init.description: A new forecast arrives once an hour. Polling more often than every 15 minutes gains nothing.
